proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ A hA h
  have h' : ProbabilityTheory.IndepSet A A P := (ProbabilityTheory.indepSet_iff_measure_inter_eq_mul hA hA P).mpr h
  exact ProbabilityTheory.measure_eq_zero_or_one_of_indepSet_self h'
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (A : Set Ω), MeasurableSet A → P (A ∩ A) = P A * P A → P A = 0 ∨ P A = 1
